text: A blurry fake-ID image was run through facial recognition and returned Nijeer Parks as a possible match. Police allegedly obtained a warrant without adequately verifying alibi evidence or disclosing the uncertainty of the technology.
asserted_by: asserting party not identified in the indexed source fields
ai_system_name: Out-of-state facial-recognition search run by a Rockland County (N.Y.) Sheriff's investigator via the New York State Intelligence Center; IDEMIA, Inc. pleaded as maker of the software (Clearview AI is not identified as the system used in the retrieved filings)
deployer: Woodbridge Police Department and intelligence-center intermediaries
canonical_source_conflicted: Actual suspect identity, alibi evidence, and warrant probable-cause standards
mitigation_gap: No adequate alibi check, DNA/fingerprint corroboration, or transparent disclosure of FRT provenance before arrest.
reliance_or_harm: Parks spent about 10 days in jail before charges were dismissed; civil-rights litigation followed, and the Township of Woodbridge settled for $300,000 in 2024 without admitting liability.
source_review_unresolved: Whether a Rule 41 dismissal order or so-ordered stipulation was entered after 2024-09-05; RECAP holds nothing after Dkt. 126 and the docket page is script-blocked.
filing_date '2022-09' is unsupported by any retrieved document; docket metadata indicates 2021-03-03 but no primary document states the removal date.
Image-only pages 20-22 and 27 of Dkt. 126 (stipulations) were not read.
The disposition of claims against IDEMIA, Inc. is not visible in the retrieved documents.
